target.title: fix(models): preserve static provider catalog metadata
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Static provider catalog conversion did not preserve all provider/model metadata consistently. The concrete current-main gap is provider-level `params`: static-catalog rows can define provider request params, but the returned runtime model did not merge those provider params with model params.

This PR also makes the static provider catalog converter explicitly carry `compat` and `mediaInput` so the returned runtime model preserves the same schema-valid metadata downstream payload and capability code expects.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime should preserve schema-valid provider/model metadata when resolving static provider catalog models. This is a metadata-propagation fix in `modelFromProviderStaticCatalog`; it does not add a new config key, policy path, transport, or custom-provider tool API.

Reviewer scope:
- This PR proves static provider catalog params/metadata propagation into the resolved runtime model and OpenAI-compatible request params via production modules.
- This PR is intentionally scoped away from the separate live-session `Tool exec not found` issue.
- Current main already keeps normal configured-provider compat flowing in other paths, and tools are permissive unless `compat.supportsTools === false`; the changed path here is static provider catalog conversion.

## User Impact

Users and bundled/provider catalogs can define provider-level request params and model metadata without losing that metadata during static provider catalog model resolution. Downstream payload generation and capability checks then receive the resolved model shape consistently.

## Evidence

Behavior or issue addressed:
- Static provider catalog conversion merges provider-level and model-level `params`, with model-level values taking precedence.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `compat` metadata.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `mediaInput` metadata.
- Live CLI proof shows `openclaw models list --all --provider cohere --json` resolving a real bundled static catalog row.
- Production helper proof shows resolved static-catalog `compat` metadata reaching `supportsModelTools(model)` and `buildOpenAICompletionsParams(...)` request shaping.
- Regression coverage verifies OpenAI completions payload construction respects resolved model metadata.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
```text
git fetch upstream main --prune
git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...upstream/main
sh -c 'git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD; printf "base_is_ancestor_of_head=%s\n" "$?"'
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts
node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
timeout 20s env OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="<tmp>" node ./openclaw.mjs models list --all --provider cohere --json
timeout 20s env OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="<tmp>" node --import tsx --input-type=module  # production helper proof below
```

Current branch state:
```text
$ git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...upstream/main
3	0
# Note: branch is ahead of upstream/main

$ sh -c 'git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD; printf "base_is_ancestor_of_head=%s\n" "$?"'
base_is_ancestor_of_head=0
```

Real behavior proof (redacted live terminal runs):
```text
$ timeout 20s env OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="<tmp>" node ./openclaw.mjs models list --all --provider cohere --json
{
  "count": 5,
  "models": [
    ...
    {
      "key": "cohere/command-a-vision-07-2025",
      "name": "Command A Vision",
      "input": "text+image",
      "contextWindow": 128000,
      "local": false,
      "available": false,
      "tags": [],
      "missing": false
    },
    ...
  ]
}
```

```text
$ timeout 20s env OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="<tmp>" node --import tsx --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { loadProviderCatalogModelsForList } from './src/commands/models/list.provider-catalog.ts';
import { supportsModelTools } from './src/agents/model-tool-support.ts';
import { buildOpenAICompletionsParams } from './src/agents/openai-transport-stream.ts';

const models = await loadProviderCatalogModelsForList({
  cfg: {},
  agentDir: process.env.OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR,
  env: process.env,
  providerFilter: 'cohere',
  staticOnly: true,
});
const model = models.find((entry) => entry.id === 'command-a-vision-07-2025');
const request = buildOpenAICompletionsParams(model, {
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'prove static catalog metadata propagation', timestamp: 1 }],
  tools: [{ name: 'proof_tool', description: 'proof-only tool', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: {}, additionalProperties: false } }],
}, { maxTokens: 1234 });

console.log(JSON.stringify({
  provider: model.provider,
  id: model.id,
  api: model.api,
  baseUrl: model.baseUrl?.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/u, 'https://redacted.example'),
  input: model.input,
  compat: model.compat,
  supportsModelTools: supportsModelTools(model),
  request: {
    model: request.model,
    max_tokens: request.max_tokens ?? null,
    max_completion_tokens: request.max_completion_tokens ?? null,
    tools: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(request, 'tools') ? request.tools : 'absent',
  },
}, null, 2));
EOF
{
  "provider": "cohere",
  "id": "command-a-vision-07-2025",
  "api": "openai-completions",
  "baseUrl": "https://redacted.example/compatibility/v1",
  "input": [
    "text",
    "image"
  ],
  "compat": {
    "supportsStore": false,
    "supportsUsageInStreaming": false,
    "supportsTools": false,
    "maxTokensField": "max_tokens"
  },
  "supportsModelTools": false,
  "request": {
    "model": "command-a-vision-07-2025",
    "max_tokens": 1234,
    "max_completion_tokens": null,
    "tools": "absent"
  }
}
```

What this proves (real CLI/helper path):
- `openclaw models list --all --provider cohere --json` resolves the real bundled static catalog row `cohere/command-a-vision-07-2025` through a user-facing CLI path.
- `loadProviderCatalogModelsForList({ providerFilter: "cohere", staticOnly: true })` resolves the same static catalog row through the production helper used by `openclaw models list`.
- The resolved model preserves static-catalog `compat.supportsTools=false` and `compat.maxTokensField="max_tokens"` metadata.
- `supportsModelTools(model)` returns `false`, proving preserved `compat.supportsTools=false` reaches the production capability helper.
- `buildOpenAICompletionsParams(...)` consumes the resolved model and emits `max_tokens: 1234` with `max_completion_tokens: null`, proving preserved `compat.maxTokensField` reaches request payload shaping.
- The supplied `proof_tool` is suppressed and request `tools` is absent, proving tool request shaping follows preserved static-catalog compatibility metadata.
- Base URL is redacted; no secrets or live provider credentials are used.
- This does not depend on live gateway state or the separate Tool exec session issue.

Local hygiene checks:
```text
$ git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
# no output

$ node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
```

Focused regression test run (real CLI):
```text
$ node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts

Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       444 passed (444)
```
